routes._comment: The cache-refresh scheduler is a Logic App timer: it has no Entra session, so the gateway would bounce it to /.auth/login/aad and the function would never see its API key (observed as a 302 in the Logic App run history). The endpoint does its own auth instead -- CACHE_REFRESH_API_KEY, or a signed-in principal, which SWA still injects here for browser callers -- and refuses everything else.

Catch-all, LAST so every anonymous exception above still wins. Without it only /, /*.html and /api/* were gated, and app_location is "/" on all four workflows -- so the repo root is the deployed site and everything else was served anonymously. Verified against production: MERGE_PLAN.md, DAN_UI_FEEDBACK.md, NON_MSP_FILTER_AUDIT.md, BULLHORN_PORT_SPEC.md, CLAUDE.md, staticwebapp.config.json, .github/workflows/* and tools/* all returned 200 with no session, carrying client names, headcounts, revenue figures and database names. ghr-commissions already runs this exact rule in production.
